evidence_quotes.agenda: 'Before I discuss the pricing and your estimate, do you have any concern about the moving process?' — asked after full logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer answered 'No' — full credit per the no-concern rule.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'If ever the move takes less than this, then you will only be charged for how much time we used during the move' — matches the 'pay less if beats it' line.

top_strength: Clearly personalized estimate (called out drive time and elevator access as factors) and handled the customer's uncertainty about walking distance gracefully by explaining the buffer built into the rate.
coaching_note: No explicit close attempt — call ends with the customer needing to check with her husband, which is fine, but the rep never asked for the booking directly to plant that seed.
